A '''six-armed alien''' served on-board a [[Unidentified Consular-class cruiser (Noggox)|freighter]] owned by [[Noggox]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. The [[Alien/Legends|alien]] was vaguely [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]], with two [[Limb/Legends|legs]], six arms, and a head.<ref name="Strange Allies" /> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Annual">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]'' places the [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Battle of the Kaliida Nebula]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. The battle takes place just prior to the ''Secret Missions'' series.</ref> the alien was on [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] when it was intercepted near [[Shipwrights' Trace/Legends|Shipwrights' Trace]] by a [[Unidentified Lucrehulk-class pirate ship|pirate ship]]. The [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] attacked and disabled the ship. The pirate [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Dool Pundar]], then ordered the freighter to surrender, and sent [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s to secure it. The alien then joined the crew in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] as Pundar absconded with the freighter and its cargo of [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brains]]. At the time, the alien was wearing a [[Color/Legends|green]] uniform and a helmet on its head, along with [[Glove/Legends|gloves]] and [[Boot/Legends|boots]]. The crew was later safely recovered.<ref name="Strange Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
The alien appears in [[2011]]'s ''[[The Clone Wars: Strange Allies]]'', a comic tie-in to the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Secret Missions]]'' series.
